exposure: Multiparous women with a history of cesarean section
cohort: 2467 pregnant women in Sweden without pre-existing diabetes who filled their first prescription for insulin or metformin in their second or third trimester
finding: Metformin use alone for gestational diabetes was not associated with an increased risk of cesarean section compared to insulin use, and was associated with a lower risk of delivering a large-for-gestational age infant.
mod_finding: This study found that metformin use alone for gestational diabetes was not associated with an increased risk of cesarean section compared to insulin use.
